subject: Planning: POC playbook session — model tiers, fallback, and load sweep coordination
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Tran <sam.tran@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC playbook session — availability and prework

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. We’re excited to run the hands-on POC playbook session and want to lock a date that covers: prompt review, routing policy design (model tiering + fallback rules), and a short load sweep to validate throughput. Proposed windows (all PT):

- Option A: Wed, Aug 11 — 09:00–11:00 (2 hours, focused workshop + short ramp)
- Option B: Thu, Aug 12 — 13:00–16:00 (3 hours, includes extra time for region checks and Q&A)

Draft agenda (attached: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf):
- 15m intro / success criteria
- 45m prompt review and expected latency profiles
- 45m routing policy: model selection, tiering, fallback order, region routing
- 30–60m load sweep (ramp + steady-state) using loadtest-template.csv

A few asks before we confirm:
- Please share the list of model variants you want us to include in the tier matrix (e.g., cost-optimized vs low-latency).
- Do you want the load sweep to emulate production traffic or staging-only traffic?
- Any regional constraints (APAC/ EU) we should account for during the ramp?

I’ve CC’d Dev and Rishi (technical) and Lauren (project coordination). I attached a loadtest template to help with traffic profiles. If you can confirm preferred slot and the model list by EOD Wed, we’ll send an updated calendar invite and a pre-run checklist.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf, loadtest-template.csv
From: Sam Tran <sam.tran@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@orbitanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: POC playbook session — availability and prework

Neha —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Thu Aug 12 (Option B) looks better for our engineering leads. A couple of quick items:

- We want the load sweep to include a short APAC-heavy window (about 15–20 min) to validate cross-region fallbacks.
- Can you confirm expected RPS per slot for the sweep? We’ll aim to mirror a 200–800 RPS distribution during the ramp, peak at ~800.
- Our procurement team will need a short procurement checklist / PO questions doc before the session (I’ve CC’d Elena).

If you can confirm the RPS plan and APAC routing approach, we’ll lock Aug 12.

Thanks,
Sam Tran
Head of Platform Engineering | Orbit Analytics
sam.tran@orbitanalytics.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Tran <sam.tran@orbitanalytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC playbook session — availability and prework

Sam —

Short technical response and proposed test plan:

Model selection recommendations for the session (we can include these as tier examples):
- Tier A (low latency): mix-7B-fp16 (optimize for 50–150 ms token latency)
- Tier B (balanced): mix-13B-quant (good throughput at modest cost)
- Tier C (cost-optimized): mix-13B-q4_0 (lower perf, cheaper)

Fallback and routing rules (proposal):
- Primary routing: US region (lowest latency) -> Secondary: EU region -> Tertiary: APAC fallback for burst overflow
- Fallback triggers: queue depth > 20 requests OR 95th percentile latency > SLO for 2 consecutive minutes
- Cache warmup: prefill KV caches with top 200 prefixes used in your traffic sample (we can use the loadtest-template.csv to build this)

Load sweep suggestion (we’ll run the template you provided):
- Ramp: 2 min (200 -> 400 RPS), 5 min (400 -> 800 RPS)
- Steady: 10 min at 800 RPS with one APAC-focused 15-min mini-sweep later in the window
- We’ll instrument token-level latency and route duplicates to a cost-tracking endpoint for per-model accounting

I’ll prepare a small snippet to wire the tiering config into the routing policy UI for the workshop. Attaching loadtest-template.csv for your quick edits.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: loadtest-template.csv
